verdict.rationale: Data export is a fair question for an inference and fine-tuning platform, but the evidence pack never documents exporting account data, uploaded datasets, or fine-tuned model weights in open formats. The OpenAI-compatible API and open-source model catalog lower switching costs for application code. That is adjacent portability, not a data-export capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
